thesis: One stable poem, many linked entrances and reversible authoring moves: PAGE/MAP/SETS expose typed relations; APERTURE controls load; candidates are previewed before explicit adoption; revisions remain attributable and returnable.

recovered_donors.name: Poemage
recovered_donors.mechanism: linked set / poem / path views; sonic topology; abstract view remains tied to original text

recovered_donors.name: Foundry Market+Solver
recovered_donors.mechanism: working bag, explicit constraints, least-change preview, blocked-state explanation

recovered_donors.name: Grid Path Compiler V3
recovered_donors.mechanism: stable identity + typed edge + path + unequal views + return; semantic zoom

recovered_donors.name: Co-PoeTryMe
recovered_donors.mechanism: user-guided constrained word/line alternatives that remain editable

recovered_donors.name: COPE
recovered_donors.mechanism: form-aware editor, dictionaries, analysis, nearest-neighbor inspiration and suggestions

implemented: manual author links and captured author paths
lightweight heuristic feedback with explicit evidence limits
aperture / visual-load control that preserves selected and AUTHOR relations first
boundaries: Map is a projection, not the poem.
SOUND is approximate Latin-script heuristic in 0.1.
No automatic semantic embedding is claimed.
Forms constrain; they do not score literary value.
ADOPT is explicit and recorded; LOCK blocks adoption.
next_experiments: intent verbs CONTINUE/REPLACE/ECHO/CONTRAST/TURN/RHYME/COMPRESS/EXPAND/SURPRISE/BREAK feeding provider-specific candidate queries
declarative form-adapter schema instead of hardcoded form UI
real phonetic/language adapters replacing approximate spelling heuristics
corpus neighborhood view with exact provenance
line/macro-glyph summary zoom for dense poems
challenge/game layer where solved constraint state remains the editable poem

current_classification.basis: Substantial workbench is implemented and usable, but receipt remains explicitly experimental with open language/corpus/game trials; historical status EXPERIMENTAL_LIVE remains above.

lineage.relation: 0.1 asks whether selective visualization can answer one named question without displacing the poem; 0.2 turns that discipline into a co-creative authoring surface.
